title: Particle Forge Command

selected_categories.reasoning: The dominant implemented system is a live physics simulation with gravity, friction, collision resolution, and boundary bouncing. While there are no authored puzzle levels, the player’s interaction revolves around manipulating a reactive physical system.

The player freely creates and reshapes the particle field with no fixed objectives or level gates. The drag-to-spawn mechanic effectively lets the player build a dynamic swarm composition in an open-ended sandbox.

The presentation emphasizes soothing audiovisual feedback, hypnotic movement, haptics, and a low-pressure loop. Much of the appeal comes from watching and feeling the swarm rather than overcoming challenge.
Continuous spawning, glowing impacts, scattering, resetting, and audiovisual responses create a tactile satisfying-toy feel. The game is structured around sensory payoff and emergent motion.

This is a weaker fit, but the toy-like, self-directed experimentation and system manipulation resemble an abstract interactive experience more than a traditional goal-based genre. It serves as a catch-all for the game’s highly nonstandard category fit.
